scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @screenvault/shared && npm run build -w @screenvault/types && npm run build -w @screenvault/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @screenvault/api && npm run build -w @screenvault/admin && npm run build -w @screenvault/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,admin,desktop -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @screenvault/api" "npm run dev -w @screenvault/admin" "npm run dev -w @screenvault/desktop"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @screenvault/api
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @screenvault/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm exec -w @screenvault/shared -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @screenvault/types -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @screenvault/ui -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @screenvault/api -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @screenvault/admin -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm exec -w @screenvault/desktop -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @screenvault/shared && npm run build -w @screenvault/types && npm run db:seed -w @screenvault/api
